NOTES: Latest Q3 reflects the favorable impact of import legislation called "Generalized System of Preferences" under which imports from Thailand are currently eligible, runs through May 31, 1997. Safeskin said it will receive a customs duty refund of $1.2 million for imports from Thailand during the period since the program expired on July 31, 1995.

The refund is reflected in a reduction in the cost of goods sold for Q3 1996. Concurrently, Safeskin has taken Q3 charges of $1.2 million in anticipation of new product introductions and related issues.

Without the estimated customs duty refund and the charges, net sales would have been $450,000 higher and the gross profit and operating expenses as a percent of net sales would have been 42 percent and 21 percent, respectively, for Q3 1996.
